name: azure-vmware-solution-enterprise
description: Enterprise Azure VMware Solution baseline with private cloud, landing network, ExpressRoute connectivity, and centralized monitoring.
what: A starter AVS landing zone that provisions the core building blocks for VMware workloads in Azure: an AVS private cloud, a landing virtual network with GatewaySubnet, baseline security controls, optional ExpressRoute gateway connectivity, and centralized monitoring in Azure Monitor.
why: Organizations migrating vSphere workloads need a governed, repeatable way to stand up AVS with secure connectivity and observability from day one. This template accelerates migration while preserving operational consistency across environments.
potentialUseCases: Datacenter exit and lift-and-shift of VMware workloads
Capacity expansion for existing on-premises vSphere clusters
Disaster recovery target for critical VMware applications
Hybrid operations while modernizing applications over time

reliability: Dedicated AVS private cloud for isolated VMware operations
Environment-specific parameterization for controlled dev/prod rollout
security: Key Vault baseline for secure secret management
Network segmentation with dedicated gateway and shared-services subnets
Optional diagnostics for AVS control-plane visibility
costOptimization: Right-size AVS node count by environment
Use dev profile for early validation before production scale
Centralized monitoring to optimize resource utilization
operationalExcellence: Infrastructure as Code modules for repeatable deployment
Unified logging via Log Analytics and Application Insights
performanceEfficiency: ExpressRoute-ready connectivity for low-latency hybrid traffic
Scalable AVS cluster size parameter to match workload demand

components.name: AVS private cloud nodes (AV36)
components.notes: Example assumes 3 nodes x 730 hours. Replace with your cluster size and region rates.

components.name: ExpressRoute gateway (ErGw2AZ)
components.notes: Optional but commonly required for hybrid AVS connectivity.

components.name: Log Analytics ingestion
components.notes: Example monthly diagnostic and platform telemetry ingestion.
